mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_biz_report WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT r.id FROM tbl_biz_report r INNER JOIN tbl_biz_algorithm g ON g.id = r.algorithm_id WHERE g.name = #{algorithmName} AND DATE(r.created_at) = #{createdAt} ORDER BY r.created_at LIMIT #{limit}) AS temp)

select g.name, count(0) conut from tbl_biz_report r inner join tbl_biz_camera_group_item i on r.camera_id = i.camera_id inner join tbl_biz_camera_group g on g.id = i.group_id WHERE created_mills > #{startMillsBox} and created_mills < #{endMillsBox} group by g.name order by conut desc
mapper.update: update tbl_biz_report set handle_time = ifnull(timestampdiff(SECOND, created_at, audit_at), 0) where (audit_result = 1 or audit_result = 2) and (handle_time = 0 or handle_time is null)
